ahnbingbing-aligned-delivery-root.description: An agile operating + coaching skill for project/program managers and team leads, grounded in a delivery philosophy (리·기·도; the lenses "unexpectancy" and "proximity"). Coaches and interviews PMs; helps you lead, grow, and care for a product/engineering team (motivation, psychological safety, 1:1s, conflict resolution, burnout, key-person departures, team merges, self-management) and manage up to stakeholders and executives (stakeholder mapping, executive alignment, escalation/RAG reporting). Diagnoses delivery health from sprint/Jira + DORA analytics — scope/completion predictability, workload…
